title: Shadow Scissors vs direct mid pressure
intro: Outcome-labelled six-cell exhibition of one geometry question: can two four-body wings take Tapline's full outer routes, assemble behind the enemy, and turn rear contact into Core pressure before a direct middle pack converts its shorter path? This is an exhibit, not a balance measurement.

cards.trigger: At least three bodies from each wing reach their rear rally zones.
cards.tactic: Four bodies travel north and four south, latch a joint breach, collapse on the enemy-side Well, and let any carrier return by the direct route.
cards.counterplay: The opponent takes the shorter middle path, banks early, then contests the returning carrier and the exposed home side.
cards.fallback: If the joint breach never forms, each wing fights contact on its ingress; after the opening window it collects known loose Cores and pressures the enemy Well normally.
cards.watch: Watch t0–110: perimeter travel, the two rear rallies, the joint collapse, and the first far-side Core return.
